Sagg Eco Village is in the Ganderbal district of central Kashmir. It sits in the Chanthan Gulabpora area, in the Wali War region on the Sindh River's foothills. A search summary puts it about 6 km from Ganderbal town. I didn't confirm that distance on a page I read.

Claims, each with its source:

- **Ganderbal:** Sagg is described as a natural farm and cultural retreat centre located in Ganderbal.
  - https://ecovillage.org/map/community/sagg-eco-village/
- **Chanthan Gulabpura, Wali War:** A local youth from Ganderbal district established it in the Chanthan Gulabpura area, at the foothills of the Sindh River in the Wali War region.
  - https://preciouskashmir.com/2022/09/21/sagg-eco-village-kashmirs-offbeat-recreational-destination/
- **Street address (search-result summary only):** Watlar Wuder, Lar–Chunt Waliwar Road, Ganderbal, J&K 191201. I did not open the pages behind this. Treat the address as unverified.
  - https://recreation.saggecovillage.earth/ (the official site; my read of it returned a 404)

Limits on the evidence:
- Each key claim rests on one page I read.
- I didn't search for contradicting sources, and I found no conflicting location.
- I didn't find exact coordinates.
